name: Data.mul_fNatural_mem_rapidOfLevel_and_hol
summary: By cosetKernelSum_eq_fNatural at ϑ = 1 and u = 1, F♮_i is a multiple of a finite sum of theta kernels; each is of level ϖ̄² and holomorphic.

steps.claim: F♮_i = c·cosetKernelSum(…) at the trivial twist (cosetKernelSum_eq_fNatural with a = CarrierIndex, u = 1).
